name: run-ledger
description: A pane of estimated API cost per run, model and source plugin, each subagent's status, and Jev's model recommendation beside the model that actually ran. Needs a TypeSafe API key; calls to api.typesafe.ai are paid.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API key
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Used to ask Jev (api.typesafe.ai) for a model recommendation when Jev model advice is not off. Calls are paid. Without a key the mod does nothing.

mode.title: Jev model advice
mode.description: off: Jev is never called. recommend: Jev recommends a model for each subagent and the pane shows it beside the model that ran. auto-route: the same, and a subagent whose call names no model runs on Jev's pick.

budgetUsd.title: Budget per subagent task (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Handed to Jev with the task, so it can weigh price against the work.
